_comment: Claude MCP Infra Assistant — Configuración de ejemplo. Copiar como ~/.claude/mcp.json o agregar al CLAUDE.md del proyecto. NUNCA incluir tokens reales.

filesystem._description: Read-only access to infrastructure repository files. Change /path/to/infra/repo to your actual path.
filesystem._security: Use --readonly flag always. Do NOT point to directories with secrets or credentials.

github._description: Read-only GitHub access for PR/issue inspection. Use a token with minimal scopes: read:org, repo (read only).

aws-readonly._description: AWS read-only access. Requires IAM policy with only describe/list/get actions (see security-guardrails.md).
aws-readonly._iam_policy_ref: See security-guardrails.md for the minimal IAM policy to attach to this user/role.

brave-search._description: Web search for infrastructure documentation, CVEs, and best practices.

_human_approval_required: Any action that creates, modifies, or deletes cloud resources
Any action that modifies repository contents (push, merge, delete branch)
Any action that changes IAM policies or security groups
Any action that stops, starts, or terminates compute instances
_allowed_read_actions: Describe running EC2 instances, RDS databases, EKS clusters
List S3 buckets and their properties (not contents)
Read GitHub PRs, issues, and repository structure
_prohibited_actions: Terminate or stop any EC2 instance
Delete any resource (S3 bucket, RDS, etc.)
Modify security groups, NACLs, or IAM policies
Access secrets from AWS Secrets Manager or SSM Parameter Store
Execute arbitrary shell commands on remote systems
Merge or push to any branch without explicit human confirmation
